name: Calendly
tagline: Scheduling automation for sharing booking links with others
painPoints: One-directional: great for inbound scheduling, not personal calendar management
No AI assistance for your own calendar or task management
Paid plans needed for most professional features like round-robin
Cannot manage your inbox, tasks, or workflows beyond scheduling links
Branded Calendly links can feel impersonal to high-value contacts
metaTitle: Calendly Alternative for Your Own Calendar: AI That Runs It
metaDescription: Calendly handles inbound booking links. GAIA manages your whole calendar, drafts scheduling emails, and creates tasks from meetings. See when to use both.
whyPeopleLook: Calendly solves one specific problem: letting others book time on your calendar without email back-and-forth. But many users find they need more than inbound scheduling — they need help managing their existing calendar, triaging email, creating tasks from meetings, and proactively organizing their day. Calendly is a piece of the puzzle; GAIA is the puzzle itself.
gaiaReplaces: Outbound scheduling via email drafting and calendar coordination
Meeting follow-up task creation from calendar events
Calendar conflict detection and proactive rescheduling
Daily schedule briefings that include upcoming meetings
gaiaAdvantages: Manages your entire calendar proactively, not just inbound scheduling
Email integration closes the loop between scheduling and inbox
Creates tasks automatically from meetings and follow-ups
Source-available and self-hostable for privacy-conscious users
Free tier available without scheduling link branding constraints
migrationSteps: Keep Calendly for external scheduling links if needed
Connect GAIA to Google Calendar for proactive personal calendar management
Enable Gmail integration so GAIA tracks meeting-related email threads
Use GAIA for daily briefings that include Calendly-booked meetings

faqs.question: Does GAIA provide scheduling links like Calendly?
faqs.answer: GAIA manages scheduling via Google Calendar and email drafting but does not provide public booking links for others to book time on your calendar. For external booking pages, Calendly can coexist with GAIA.

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace Calendly for scheduling meetings?
faqs.answer: For scheduling meetings with people you communicate with over email, yes — GAIA can handle the coordination. For sharing a public booking link on your website or LinkedIn, Calendly remains useful.

faqs.question: Is GAIA cheaper than Calendly Teams?
faqs.answer: Calendly Teams is a paid per-seat plan. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month for an individual with much broader capabilities. Self-hosted GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs).

faqs.question: Does GAIA create tasks from meetings automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can analyze calendar events and create follow-up tasks automatically — for example, creating a task to send meeting notes after a call ends.

comparisonRows.gaia: Assistant that manages your whole calendar proactively, not just a booking page for inbound meetings
comparisonRows.competitor: External booking-link tool that lets other people self-schedule meetings on your calendar based on availability rules you configure

comparisonRows.gaia: Coordinates scheduling outbound too: drafts the email, proposes slots from real availability, and books it
comparisonRows.competitor: Generates shareable booking pages with configurable availability; invitees pick a slot and the event is added to your calendar automatically

comparisonRows.gaia: Handles inbound requests conversationally from any channel, then follows through with prep and follow-ups
comparisonRows.competitor: Core feature: unlimited event types on paid plans with custom availability windows, buffer times, team round-robin, and collective scheduling

comparisonRows.gaia: Reads your inbox and connects scheduling threads to the calendar, closing the loop booking links leave open
comparisonRows.competitor: Sends automated confirmation, reminder, and follow-up emails tied to booked events; cannot read or triage your inbox

comparisonRows.gaia: Synthesizes context from email, tasks, and past meetings into a briefing before every call
comparisonRows.competitor: No meeting briefing capability; shows event details and invitee answers to intake questions, but does not synthesize context from your other tools

comparisonRows.gaia: Creates tasks automatically from meetings and follow-ups, so booked events turn into owned work
comparisonRows.competitor: No task management; workflow automation on Teams and Enterprise plans can trigger actions in connected tools like Salesforce or HubSpot after a booking

comparisonRows.gaia: Scheduling workflows you describe in words, spanning inbox, calendar, and task tools
comparisonRows.competitor: Event-triggered workflows for reminders, follow-up emails, and webhook notifications; no natural-language automation builder

comparisonRows.competitor: Integrates with Google, Outlook, and Office 365 calendars; connects to Zoom, Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, Zapier, and others for post-booking actions

comparisonRows.gaia: Source-available and self-hostable for privacy-conscious teams
comparisonRows.competitor: Proprietary closed-source SaaS; no self-hosting option
